title: GTA6 Horizon: New GTA 5 Leak Reveals Scrapped City-Sized DLC Plans
description: A new GTA 5 leak suggests Rockstar Games once planned ambitious city-sized DLCs. We explore what this means for the future and development of GTA6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Uncovering the Lost Ambitions of GTA 5

According to a recent report by IGN Games, a new leak surrounding GTA 5 has surfaced, suggesting that Rockstar Games once had remarkably ambitious, city-sized DLC plans for the game that were ultimately scrapped.

For years, the absence of single-player expansions for GTA 5 has been a prominent talking point within the community. While the phenomenal financial and cultural success of GTA Online ultimately shifted Rockstar's development focus toward multiplayer updates, this latest leak provides a fascinating glimpse into what could have been. The data and traces left in the files indicate that a massive expansion of the game's world was actively considered during its lifecycle.

## Connecting the Past to the Future of GTA 6

While this leak pertains to the past and remains part of the unconfirmed rumor ecosystem surrounding the game's development history, it inevitably sparks speculation regarding GTA 6. As fans eagerly await the launch of the next chapter set in Vice City and the broader state of Leonida, looking back at Rockstar's grand unfulfilled blueprints offers valuable context.

Industry analysts and players alike are left to wonder whether the lessons learned from shelving these expansive city-sized add-ons for GTA 5 might influence Rockstar's post-launch strategy for GTA 6. Could we see future map expansions that bring back iconic locations? Only time will tell, and all official plans remain strictly under wraps by the developer.

Ultimately, this leak highlights the sheer scale of Rockstar's world-building ambitions. As we edge closer to the era of GTA 6, understanding these historical development pivots helps contextualize the immense scope of modern open-world game design.

## Editor's Take

The revelation of scrapped city-sized DLCs for GTA 5 is both bittersweet and revealing. It shows just how vast Rockstar's original visions can be, even when commercial realities force them to shift focus. For GTA6, we can only hope these grand ambitions finally find a proper outlet in the modern era.
